in_sanskrit.name: Sahebrao
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Owner of the Fort
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahebrao एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sahebrao is a Sanskrit and Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit words saha (with) and brahman (god). The name means 'Owner of the Fort'. Sahebrao was a name borne by many Maratha kings and chieftains in Maharashtra.
